Proposition
[weighted $L^2$ monotonicity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0075, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0076 1. ch10:10.68\group Weak heat solutions

If $\partial _tg=-2h$, $\operatorname {tr}_gh\ge -K_1$, and $u(\partial _tu-\Delta u)\le 0$ with $u\partial _ u u\le 0$, then for every Lipschitz $\xi $ satisfying $\xi _t+ rac12| abla \xi |^2\le 0$, \[ e^{-K_1t}\int u^2e^\xi \, d\mu _t \] is nonincreasing.
Proof

\sketch Differentiate under the integral, use $\partial _td\mu _t=-(\operatorname {tr}_gh)d\mu _t$, the differential inequality for $\xi $, and integrate by parts. The result is

\[ -2e^{-K_1t}\int | abla (ue^{\xi /2})|^2d\mu _t\le 0, \]

including the nonpositive boundary term.

□
